1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la situación en que se encuentra ‘la mujer soltera ya entrada en años’, Maura. “Quizás fue el temor de quedarme solterona: las jamonas empedernidas me horrorizaban.” Ana Lydia Vega y Carmen Lugo Filippi, Vírgenes y mártires, p. 28.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This term refers to the situation of a "spinster" who is already advanced in age, as described by Maura. The fear of becoming an unmarried woman may have been a concern, particularly for those who are perceived as being stubbornly single, or "jamona empedernida".
